files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.shop core.legend
    namespace=kids.shop
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Prices in lei, pocket money, baskets, buying, change"

@kids.shop.price core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="One item of a kind costs some number of lei. The knowledge base holds the price list; a price stated in the dialog overrides it."
    example="A ball costs 5 lei."

@kids.shop.price.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which item?"

@kids.shop.price.cost core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does one of them cost?"
    compute=true
@kids.shop.price.phrase core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="How do we say one of them (for example a loaf of bread)?"

@kids.shop.price.plural core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="How do we say several of them (for example loaves of bread)?"

@kids.shop.money core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The user has some lei now (this sets the amount of money)."
    example="I have 20 lei."

@kids.shop.money.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the user have?"

@kids.shop.money.unit core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which money unit is it?"

@kids.shop.income core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="The user gets some lei."
    example="I found 5 lei."

@kids.shop.income.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the user get?"

@kids.shop.income.unit core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which money unit is it?"

@kids.shop.expense core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="The user spends or loses some lei."
    example="I spent 5 lei."

@kids.shop.expense.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the user spend?"

@kids.shop.expense.unit core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which money unit is it?"

@kids.shop.purchase core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="The user buys some items; the money is taken from the amount of money the user has."
    example="I buy 2 pencils."

@kids.shop.purchase.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What does the user buy?"

@kids.shop.purchase.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of them does the user buy?"

@kids.shop.balance core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How much money the user has now, after every income, expense and purchase."
    example="How much money do I have left?"

@kids.shop.balance.amount core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the user have now?"
    compute=true
@kids.shop.total core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="What a basket of one or two kinds of items costs."
    example="How much do 3 pencils cost?"

@kids.shop.total.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the first kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.total.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the first kind?"

@kids.shop.total.item2 core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the second kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.total.count2 core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the second kind?"

@kids.shop.total.total core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the basket cost?"
    compute=true
@kids.shop.affordability core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Yes or no: does the user have enough money for a basket?"
    example="Can I buy a book?"

@kids.shop.affordability.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the first kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.affordability.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the first kind?"

@kids.shop.affordability.item2 core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the second kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.affordability.count2 core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the second kind?"

@kids.shop.affordability.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true
@kids.shop.change core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How much change the user gets when paying a given amount for a basket."
    example="What is the change from 50 lei if I buy a book?"

@kids.shop.change.paid core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei does the user pay?"

@kids.shop.change.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the first kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.change.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the first kind?"

@kids.shop.change.item2 core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the second kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.change.count2 core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the second kind?"

@kids.shop.change.amount core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei of change does the user get?"
    compute=true

@kids.shop.leftafter core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How much money the user would have left after buying a basket (a what-if: nothing is recorded)."
    example="How much money do I have left after I buy 2 pencils?"

@kids.shop.leftafter.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the first kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.leftafter.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the first kind?"

@kids.shop.leftafter.item2 core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What is the second kind of item in the basket?"

@kids.shop.leftafter.count2 core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the second kind?"

@kids.shop.leftafter.amount core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many lei would the user have left?"
    compute=true

@kids.shop.negated core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The user did not buy, spend, get or give something. It is understood and said back, and nothing changes: the money and the purchases are not touched."
    example="I do not buy the ball."
    negative="I buy the ball."

@kids.shop.negated.verb core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What did not happen (buy, spend, get, give)?"

@kids.shop.negated.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What would have been bought?"

@kids.shop.negated.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many items or lei (when a number was said)?"

files.matrix.operations.sop:
@op.kids.shop.revise core.operation
    impl=matrix
    semantics=action
    action=shop.revise
    doc="Matrix mode: the count of the user's last purchase is changed (a default is withdrawn); the money follows."

@op.kids.shop.gotBack core.operation
    impl=matrix
    semantics=action
    action=shop.gotBack
    doc="Matrix mode: the user got some lei back for an item; what was paid is not known yet."

@op.kids.shop.whatPaid core.operation
    impl=matrix
    semantics=action
    action=shop.whatPaid
    doc="Matrix mode: what the user paid for the item they got change for, found by abduction."
files.matrix.patterns.sop:
@pat.kids.shop.m.revise core.pattern
    match="{n:number} of them"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=shop.revise arg.count={n}"
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Three of them."

@pat.kids.shop.m.gotback core.pattern
    match="i got {n:number} lei back for [a|an|the|one]? {i1:lex.kids.shop.items}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=shop.gotBack arg.item={i1} arg.back={n}"
    kind=request
    priority=14
    example="I got 5 lei back for a book."
    canonical="I got 5 lei back for a book."

@pat.kids.shop.m.whatpaid core.pattern
    match="what did i pay"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=shop.whatPaid"
    kind=request
    priority=14
    example="What did I pay?"
    canonical="What did I pay?"

@pat.kids.shop.m.buy.the core.pattern
    match="i [$kids.shop.g95_buy] [the|that|this] {i1:lex.kids.shop.items}"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.purchase item={i1}"
    kind=statement
    priority=12
    example="I buy the ball."
